name: 08232 · Pleasantville, NJ
findings: ZIP 08232 (Pleasantville) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08232 (Pleasantville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
